column1: # Dual-OTA layout for 4MB flash: two app slots (firmware OTA) + LittleFS (blocklist).
# Slots are 0x180000 (1.575MB): the REAL binary image is ~1.50MB — note PlatformIO's
# checkprogsize under-reports vs the actual flashed image (~54KB smaller estimate)
# which bricked the first boot with 0x160000 slots. Trust `ls -l firmware.bin`
